audits.text:
## df84ec34ba5d

**Reproduced defect: advertised exact controls are inert and invalid controls are silently accepted.** Audited generator SHA-256: `e07749faf5ed0c89ffdca40ab62f846150684bde3d38387ec47bd3f3747d1cc2`.

The generator declares `palette_kind`, `n_majority`, `palette_size`, `position_bias`, `n_distinct_colors`, `density`, and helpful `texture` values, but ordinary generation consumes none of them. The retained probe used seed `123`, medium difficulty, and sample indices `0..9`. For each of 15 override cases—including valid min/max majority/palette/distinct-color values, warm/cool palettes, warm/varied textures, invalid single-value axes, an unknown axis, and out-of-range values—all 10 calls were accepted and all 10 outputs were byte-identical to the no-override baseline. Positive controls for grid shape and the special `empty_rows` branch changed output, proving the comparison can detect controls the implementation actually uses (`checks/audit/df84ec34ba5d/probe.json`; script `checks/audit/df84ec34ba5d/probe.py`).

The official defect lint independently flags the source: one blocking texture-domain-overlap issue plus 174 warnings, including 168 strict-scalar detections, four dead helpful textures, a permissive self-check impostor, and a `no_majority` negative fixture that passes `self_check` (`checks/audit/df84ec34ba5d-defect-lint/result.json`). The combined audit also found no task-local/frozen tests and no semantic contract (`checks/audit/df84ec34ba5d-combined/result.json`).

Suggested owner repair: validate call scalars and unknown overrides, either implement each advertised exact axis or remove it from `AXES`, separate negative fixtures from the ordinary valid texture domain, and add a semantic contract plus focused override tests. I made no changes to this audit-only target.

Neither target was edited; all execution results remain reviewer-reported.
